questions.question: Where should the full stop be placed in the following sentence? "He finished his speech the audience applauded enthusiastically"

options.A: He finished his speech. The audience applauded enthusiastically.
options.B: He finished his speech; the audience applauded enthusiastically.
options.C: He finished his speech, the audience applauded enthusiastically.
options.D: He finished his speech: the audience applauded enthusiastically.

questions.explanation: The question specifically asks where the full stop should be placed. Option A correctly places the full stop after 'speech' to separate the two independent clauses: 'He finished his speech. The audience applauded enthusiastically.'
